scope_notes: Per-case cost = Deepgram (nova-3-medical) + Anthropic Opus 4.7 (L4 SOAP) + Anthropic Sonnet 4.6 (LLM-as-judge). Production cost per visit is HIGHER than these numbers because the production pipeline runs L1-L7 (entities, critique, polish, ICD coding, CPT coding, Rx drafts, referrals, patient summary) — this baseline measures L1 + L4 + judge only. Use this as the LOWER BOUND of per-visit cost; expand the methodology in v2 to capture the full pipeline.

alert_thresholds.blocking_budget: monthly_total_above 1500 USD at projected pilot volume
